name: Generic Identification 4
definition: Information related to an identification, eg, party identification or account identification.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifier issued to a person for which no specific identifier has been defined.

IdentificationType.name: Identification Type
IdentificationType.definition: Specifies the nature of the identifier.|Usage: IdentificationType is used to specify what kind of identifier is used. It should be used in case the identifier is different from the identifiers listed in the pre-defined identifier list.
